# ParlayPal

ParlayPal is a sportsbook-independent live bet companion for sports bettors. It reads bet-slip screenshots, normalizes straight bets and multi-leg player props, tracks game data, and builds a transparent personal betting record.

## Product

- Upload a screenshot from FanDuel, DraftKings, BetMGM, PrizePicks, or another sportsbook.
- Review extracted legs before tracking begins.
- Follow player, team, and market progress as games happen.
- Receive milestone notifications through the dashboard and supported push channels.
- Compare performance by player, team, sport, market, and ticket size.
- Join public or private creator communities to discuss picks and live tickets.

## Public pages

- [ParlayPal home](https://myparlaypal.com/): product overview, supported sports, workflow, features, and pricing.
- [Pricing](https://myparlaypal.com/#pricing): current Free, Pro, and Creator plans.
- [Football bet tracking](https://myparlaypal.com/sports/football): NFL and NCAA football markets, score updates, and player props.
- [Basketball bet tracking](https://myparlaypal.com/sports/basketball): NBA, WNBA, and NCAA basketball markets and player progress.
- [Baseball bet tracking](https://myparlaypal.com/sports/baseball): MLB scores, innings, run lines, totals, and supported props.
- [Hockey bet tracking](https://myparlaypal.com/sports/hockey): NHL scores, periods, puck lines, totals, and supported props.
- [Soccer bet tracking](https://myparlaypal.com/sports/soccer): match scores, minutes, result markets, totals, and supported props.
- [MMA bet tracking](https://myparlaypal.com/sports/mma): UFC and supported fight moneylines, methods, and round markets.
- [Tennis bet tracking](https://myparlaypal.com/sports/tennis): ATP, WTA, match scores, handicaps, totals, and supported props.
- [Racing bet tracking](https://myparlaypal.com/sports/racing): NASCAR, Formula 1, positions, laps, and finish markets.
- [Golf bet tracking](https://myparlaypal.com/sports/golf): PGA, LIV, LPGA, leaderboard, finish, and matchup markets.
- Public scorecards: `https://myparlaypal.com/u/{username}` when a bettor has enabled a public profile.
- Public communities: `https://myparlaypal.com/communities/{slug}` when a creator publishes a public community.

## Trust and scope

ParlayPal tracks bets but is not a sportsbook or gambling operator. Public scorecards use verified ticket outcomes; private records and uploaded screenshots are not public. Users should follow local laws and gamble responsibly.
